capture.method: HTTPS GET with curl 8.7.1; response body decoded as UTF-8

semantic_snapshot.selection: the first div whose id is exactly Call-for-Papers, including descendant text nodes through its matching closing tag
semantic_snapshot.normalization: HTMLParser(convert_charrefs=True), join data chunks with U+0020, then replace every Unicode whitespace run with one U+0020 and strip the ends

criterion_locators.locator: Call for Papers introduction and Evaluation Criteria > Full papers

retention.reason: The publisher page exposes no redistribution license. This receipt preserves byte and normalized-semantic hashes without mirroring the page.
retention.drift_rule: A different normalized semantic hash requires curator review and a new criterion version; it must not silently replace this receipt.
